chapter.verse: Tu-in amaute Amphipolis khua leh Apollonia khua a nawk khit uh ciangin Jew vengkhawm inn a omna Thessalonica khua tung uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul zong ama' zatngei bangin vengkhawm inn ah pai a, Sabbath ni thumvei dong Pasian' Laibupi siksanin mite tawh thu kikum hi.
Khris gim a thuak kulin misite' lakpan a thawhkik kul ahihna gentelin lakcian a, “Note' kianga kong pulak tua Jesu pen Khris hi,” ci hi.
Amaute kimkhat in tua thu pomcian thei uh a, Pasian a bia Greek tampitak leh numei thupite tawmno khatte mah bangin Paul leh Silas pawlpih uh hi.

Ahi zongin Jew mite thangpai ahih manin konglak migilo kimkhat tonpih uh a, mihon sosuahin khua sung gamlumsak uh hi. Tua ciangin mihonpi' kiangah Paul leh Silas paikhiatpih nuamin Jason' inn busim uh hi.
A muh loh uh ciangin Jason leh sanggamte kimkhat khua-uk uliante' kiang kaitaalin awng uh a, “Leitung a tokbuai hih mite, hih takah zong hong tung ta uh hi.
Jason in amaute zintungsak a, Jesu a kici kumpi dang khat om ci-in a vekun Caesar' thubullette langpangin gamta uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Hih thute a za mihonpi leh khua-uk uliante lungmang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jason leh a dang teng' tungpan kiciamna sum a lak khit uh ciangin amaute khah uh hi.
Sanggamte in Paul leh Silas Berea ah zan hunin paisak pah uh a, amaute a tun uh ciangin Jew vengkhawm inn ah lut uh hi.
Hih Jew mite pen Thessalonica khua Jew mite sangin lungsim kihongzaw uh ahih manin kinna tak tawh Pasian' thu sang uh a, tua thute hi-hilo a theih nadingun nisimin Pasian' Laibupi entel uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute tampitak in um uh a, a zahtak-huai Greek numei leh pasal tawmno khatte in zong um uh hi.
Ahih hangin Thessalonica khua-a Jew mite in Berea khua ah Paul in Pasian' thu pulak cih thu a zak uh ciangin amau zong hong pai uh a, mihonpi holhthawhin sosuah uh hi.
Tua ciangin sanggamte in tuipi piaudung dong a pai dingin Paul kha pah uh a, Silas leh Timothy ahihleh tua takah taamsuak uh hi.
Paul a va khate in Athens khua dong paipih uh a, ama' kiangah Silas leh Timothy a manlang theithei-in hong pai nading cih thupiak a ngah khit uh ciangin amaute zong ciah uh hi.
Tu-in Paul in Athens khua ah Silas leh Timothy ngakin a om laitak tua khua milim tawh kidim cih a muh ciangin ama' sungah a kha kiphawng hi.
Tua hangin vengkhawm inn ah Jew mite leh Pasian a bia mite tawh ahi zongin, nisimin sumbuktual ah mi a kituahpihte tawh ahi zongin thu kikum hi.

Epicurean leh Stoic thuthuk ngaihsun mipilte kimkhat zong Paul tawh thu kinial uh hi. Amaute kimkhat in, “Hih a pum ciakciak mipa' gennop bang ahi hiam?” ci uh a, a dangte in, “Amah pen gamdang dawi pasiante' thu a pulakpa hihtuak hi,” ci uh hi. A cihna uh a hang pen Paul in Jesu leh thawhkikna tawh kisai lungdamna thu tangko ahih man hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Paul samin Areopagus thukhen zumpi ah paipih uh a, “Tu-a na pulak hilhcianna thak bang hiam cih nong theisak thei ding hiam?
A hang pen ko' lunglut theih ding thu a lamdang kimkhat nong keng hi. Tua hi a, hih thute a khiatna ka thei nuam uh hi,” ci uh hi.
A hang pen Athens khuamite leh tua taka teeng khualmite a vekun thu thak khatpeuh genna ngaihna vai cihloh bangmah dang ah hun beisak lo uh hi.
Tua hangin Paul zong Areopagus uliante' laizang ah dingin hih bangin thugen hi: “Athens khuamite aw, note na khempeuh ah biaknami mahmah cih kong mu hi.

A hang pen ka lampai kawmin na biakte uh ka ettel ciangin biakpiaktau khat tungah, ‘Theihloh pasian' tungah,’ cih lai kikhuak khat zong ka tuakkha hi. Tua ahih manin hih, theihloh pi-a na biak pen uh ii thu, kong pulak ding hi.
Leitung leh a sunga om nate khempeuh a bawl Pasian pen vantung leh leitung a uk Topa ahih manin mihing' khut tawh kibawl thoihna innnote sungah teeng lo hi.
Amahmah in mi khempeuh tungah nuntakna leh husanna leh na khempeuh pia ahih manin kisap a nei dan khatin mihing' donna la lo hi.
Amah in leitung maitang citeng ah a teeng dingin mi khat tungtawnin leimi minam khempeuh bawl a, a hunte uh sehkholhsakin a tenna mun uh ciangtansak hi.
Tua pen mite in Pasian hong zongin a zawtkha a mukha khawng hong om mawkmawk khakleh cihna ahi hi. A taktak, amah pen eite khat ciat tawh a kigamla hilo hi.
A hang pen “‘Ama' sungah eite nungta-in gamtangin mihing hihna i nei hi, ’kici a, note' laka kamlawh laphuakte in zong hih bangin gen uh hi: “‘A hang pen eite zong ama' suanlekhakte i hi hi.’
Tua hi a, Pasian' suanlekhakte i hih manin Pasian pen kham ahi-a ngun ahi-a suang ahi zongin mihing' khutsiamna leh lunggeelna tawh a kibawl milim khat bang hi i cihkhak loh ding ahi hi.
Pasian in thutheihloh hunte a thudon loh hangin tu-in ahihleh mun citenga om mi khempeuh a kisik nadingun thupia ta hi.

A hang pen ama' sehsa mi khat tungtawnin dikna thu tawh leitung mite' tungah a thukhen ding ni kipsak khinzo a, tua a seh mipa misite' lakpan a thawhkiksakna tawh tua thu mi khempeuh tungah lahcianna pia hi.”
Paul' thugen, misite' lakpan thawhkikna thu, tua mite in a zak uh ciangin kimkhat in zahpih uh hi. Ahih hangin a dangte in, “Hih tawh kisai na thugen khatvei kong ngai lai ding uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' laizang pan Paul paikhia hi.
Ahih hangin mi kimkhat in amah beelin thu um uh a, tuate lakah Dionysius minnei Areopagus ulian khat, Damaris minnei numei khat, leh amau' kianga om midangte kihel uh hi.
